cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: 完整方案含冻结0.6B文本embedding模型、基于Qwen3式checkpoint适配的16层四head事件decoder、私有多内容label receipts、双塔训练、SageMaker近线服务与生产A/B。完整链路不在短时单A100/A30或Mac预算内且私有合同缺失；仅CPU协议三seed预期不足30秒，不下载模型/数据或调用API。
cost_assessment.model_scale: The full path includes a frozen0.6B text embedding model, an adapted Qwen3-style16-layer/four-head event decoder, private multicontent label receipts, two-tower training, SageMaker serving and production experiments. Private contracts and the campaign exceed this short single-device budget. CPU protocol cases should take under30seconds/three seeds without model/data downloads or APIs.
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: Fixed source and measured paper configuration; no local complete-campaign timing or costly probe.
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅低成本组件/接口

summary: LSER在双塔召回的用户侧融合会话、较长期历史、请求特征与可选LLM语义向量。较重encoder异步nearline计算，在线请求只读取已完成向量并融合/ANN检索。LLM路径并不替代BERT4Rec式encoder，而提供同一时间窗口的补充语义视角。 只实现显式事件的point-in-time切分与已完成缓存向量选择。调用方必须先将events/records隔离为同一user并完成资格过滤与catalog映射；本接口没有user_id权限隔离，不是完整生产防泄漏系统。缺必需向量时显式要求外部cold-start；LLM缺失或关闭时需外部兼容baseline fusion，不能自动改变治疗模型的输入维度。按最大as_of选择和丢弃不完整LLM pair是本地handoff保护约定，不是论文规定的TTL或具体fallback算法。没有BGE/Qwen encoder、16层decoder、InfoNCE训练、私有label receipt、真实embedding store、ANN或模型冷启动。绝不生成假向量，encoder_calls始终为0；这是L0接口而非召回能力。

online_ab_review.treatment: BERT4Rec-style learned retrieval and nearline serving; LLM vectors disabled
online_ab_review.limits: Online result cannot be attributed to optional LLM features; dedicated production LLM toggle is future work.
